Title: Introducing Sim Consults
NewsSummary: CIME has set a new standard at the beginning of the year by introducing Sim Consults, a pioneering initiative aimed at raising awareness about healthcare simulation and fostering its utilization across regions and beyond.
NewsContent:
In a ground-breaking accomplishment, CIME has set a new standard at the beginning of the year by introducing Sim Consults, a pioneering initiative aimed at raising awareness about healthcare simulation and fostering its utilization across regions and beyond. Sim Consults represent a significant step towards democratizing access to simulation resources and expertise, making them more accessible to healthcare professionals worldwide.

Location is no barrier; our weekly sessions are conducted online every Friday from 12-1 pm PKT, 10-11 am EAT, and 7-8 am GMT. Sim Consults provide a unique opportunity for individuals to engage with our teams directly, free of charge and without hassle. Whether seeking information on healthcare simulation fundamentals, grappling with booking simulation sessions at CIME, or unsure where to begin, Sim Consults offer personalized guidance and support from experts in the field.

Sim Consults transcend geographical boundaries, serving as a global outreach endeavour that welcomes participants from diverse backgrounds and locations. By fostering dialogue and collaboration among healthcare simulation enthusiasts worldwide, CIME is building bridges that connect hearts and minds, driving innovation and excellence in healthcare education and practice.
